messages:
sam: FYI embed-worker in eu-west1 spiking 503s since ~23:12 UTC. suspect memo cache race. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123. need expedited hotfix in 02:00-02:30 UTC window. need 2 approvals + oncall ack.
kai: Im oncall and can cover. +1 for expedited.
opsbot: Incident created #INC-8342. Owner: sam. Severity: P2.
riley: Please include rollback command and pin image. Also draft release note.
sam: Rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/embed-worker embed-worker=gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-abc123 && kubectl rollout status deployment/embed-worker -n prod` Pin: sha-def456.
kai: Canary skip criteria?
sam: Candidate passed unit/integration/e2e in CI. Staging ran 12m with 0 5xx. ops present. I approve canary skip for eu-west1. Need one more approver.
riley: +1 :thumbsup: happy to second.
deploybot: Canary bypass authorized. CI summary for PR #4123: unit: pass, integration: pass, e2e: pass, load: flaky(ignored). Candidate image gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-def456.
sam: Deploying: `/deploy release embed-worker --image sha-def456 --region eu-west1 --skip-canary` Start 02:03 UTC.
deploybot: START DEPLOY  eu-west1  pulling image -> updating pods -> readiness checks.
deploybot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: 6/6 ready. Post-deploy health checks (120s) running.
deploybot: METRICS (5m): 503-rate before 0.9% -> after 0.01%. p99 latency within SLO.
releasebot: Saved note: hotfix(embed-worker): fix memo cache race causing intermittent 503s in EU. Deployed sha-def456 to eu-west1 at 02:03 UTC. Ops rollback command attached. https://docs.redwood/release-notes/4123-hotfix-embed-worker
kai: Monitoring looks good, alerts cleared. Approving close. Recommend backport to 1.8.x later.
sam: Filing backport PR and updating changelog. Final check at 02:30 UTC: systems nominal. thanks all!
